description: This file defines a PHP driver for Oracle 8.0.5 (oci8) as part of the ADOdb database abstraction library. It includes class definitions for handling database connections and recordsets specific to the OCI805 driver, along with a method to optimize result set limiting using Oracle hints.

classes.name: ADODB_oci805
classes.description: A class extending ADODB_oci8, representing the Oracle 8i (OCI8) database driver with specific optimizations for Oracle 8.0.5.

classes.name: ADORecordset_oci805
classes.description: A class extending ADORecordset_oci8, representing recordsets specific to the oci805 driver.

methods.name: SelectLimit
methods.description: Overrides the base method to add an Oracle-specific hint (FIRST_ROWS) to optimize query performance when limiting result sets.
